title: Trove meeting
description: One line of meetings/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: one record per meeting (not per utterance); transcripts ride as sidecar artifacts. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the meeting started (= started when known; falls back to the export's or file's date for sources with no start time)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key: a source-unique meeting id (Granola note id, Fathom/Read.ai/tl;dv meeting id, Fireflies transcript id, Zoom meeting UUID, Meet conference record id, Webex instance id, a content hash for export imports)

title.description: meeting title / topic (export imports may carry none)

started.description: RFC3339 local meeting start, when the source reports it

ended.description: RFC3339 local meeting end, when the source reports it

platform.description: conferencing platform the meeting ran on: "zoom" | "meet" | "teams" | "webex" | … (the recorder's own brand, verbatim, when that's all that's known)

attendees.description: raw handles — lowercased emails / service ids (not display names)

attendee_names.description: display names, positionally paired with attendees where the source gives both

summary.description: AI summary / notes, markdown (omitted by sources that yield only transcripts, e.g. Meet)
examples:
## Decisions
- Ship the meetings contract first

recording_url.description: link to the recording, when the source exposes a durable one

folder.description: the notetaker's own folder / workspace label for the meeting

transcript_ref.description: vault-relative path to the transcript sidecar (the source's raw file or a copied artifact); omitted when no transcript exists

extra.description: everything source-specific (action items, keywords, speaker analytics, sentence-level AI tags, Drive Doc refs, …)
